description: Airport Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Tariqul Hasan. "Weak lane disciplined heterogeneous traffic conditions collected from the Dhaka-Mymensingh Highway (Airport Highway) in Bangladesh, representing a complex, undisciplined driving environment. 400-meter straight segment of Airport Highway has four through lanes in each direction, with a total width of 14.48 m. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
